findings.title: Ordinary authorized producer Services are refused by the coordinator-only guard
findings.trigger: Use the separate actual operation-specific Service required for context/session, challenge submission, classification, failure, change preparation or review.
findings.code_correspondence: integrated_guard.guard_host accepts only workflow-transition/workflow-participation or integrated-challenge-resolution/integrated-participation policies. AuthorizedAPIProducer and FormalSessionCapture call that guard on their separate original producer Service before invoking Service.call. Those Services intentionally retain their own different policies.
findings.impact: The concrete ordinary producer path refuses before dispatch; construction of all28 callable objects is not execution closure. This directly affects ordinary API routes and formal Session capture whose producer policy falls outside that closed guard.
findings.required_change: Keep the original coordinator guard unchanged. Add/select an exact separate producer-Service/source/policy boundary appropriate to each original operation, preserving actual Service/ReaderChannel origins, operation-specific policy, principal/scope/cut, full source/custody and original call authorization/nonce/deadline/effect/journal guards. Do not reuse workflow permission or broaden integrated_guard to admit arbitrary producers.

findings.title: Before-snapshot omits attachment checks for selected output-root prefixes
findings.code_correspondence: snapshot opens each selected relative prefix into opened descriptors but never records its parent/name/child attachment in links. walk checks recursive descendants and attached(links) checks the custody-root ancestors, leaving the selected prefix itself unchecked.
findings.impact: A replaced/detached selected prefix can make the before-membership snapshot describe an old directory rather than the selected pathname. capture's already-present exclusion can consequently omit preexisting selected files, although its later leaf/ancestor capture checks are otherwise complete.
findings.required_change: Record and verify every selected prefix component's held identity and parent attachment before returning the snapshot, including empty prefixes and refusal paths. Retain all uncertain directories/files and add a bounded owned replacement control. This is a missing declared attachment invariant, not a claim of a tested exploit or stronger arbitrary same-UID atomic execution.

findings.title: Unconditional body/container scope equality rejects supported mixed-scope native originals
findings.code_correspondence: Original ArtifactRef scope is selected store/container scope. T14 typed_records follows that convention and preserves target body scope unchanged; its owned pure fixture explicitly supports distinct body and container scopes. T31 requires the parsed body scope/project scope to equal that header/container scope except for migration manifests.
findings.impact: Conditional compatibility gap: supported mixed-scope native originals cannot pass this output reader. It is not asserted that every current review-only selected packet has distinct scopes or that a genuine mixed-scope native packet has run.
findings.required_change: Define and independently select an explicit versioned private producer-backed scope contract joining container/header authority, exact original body semantic scope and current Work/source lineage. Preserve original bytes/headers and all authorization checks; neither rewrite bodies/headers nor silently waive scope equality for arbitrary records. Coordinate T14/T31 peers in one revision batch.

findings.title: Responded stage selects the eligible-only open challenge submission producer
findings.code_correspondence: Both eligible and responded select AuthorizedAPIProducer over original challenge.submit. Original ChallengeSubmission strictly requires a fresh identity, empty successor_refs and payload.response_state open, resolution_decision_ref none and empty residue. Its claim ceiling is eligible candidate submission; the adapter checks operation and carrier closure but selects no response-stage implementation or response correspondence.
findings.impact: A second newly open submission is not evidence that this challenge reached a genuine response stage. The original kernel's separately bound named satisfaction obligation remains valuable but does not turn the selected eligible-only output producer into a response mechanism.
findings.required_change: Select a genuine original response-stage producer or explicit versioned response capture contract with exact challenge/contract/response/source/authority lineage. Preserve original workflow obligations and do not fabricate response state, owner evidence or implicit admission. Keep this exact stage unqualified until the actual response path exists and passes.
